scores.verdict: AI-ready: readable by AI tools and visible in search. Keep it fresh.

findings.title: Title length outside the display window
findings.evidence: Title is 14 chars: “Pricing & Fees”. Search snippets truncate around 60 chars.
findings.fix: Rewrite to 50–60 chars, front-load the primary keyword, keep the brand suffix: e.g. “<Primary Keyword> — <Brand>”.

findings.title: No author or date metadata
findings.evidence: Fetch found no author and no published date — AI answer engines weight provenance when choosing sources to cite.
findings.fix: Add author byline markup: <meta name="author" content="…">, a visible byline, and datePublished/author in JSON-LD.

findings.title: Heavy repeated boilerplate in extraction
findings.evidence: 30% of extracted lines repeat 3+ times (nav/footer/promo residue) — this dilutes the content an AI quotes.
findings.fix: Wrap navigation and repeated promo blocks in <nav>/<footer> or remove them from the content area so extractors can drop them.

findings.title: 5 H1 tags on one page
findings.evidence: Extraction found 5 <h1> elements; a single H1 makes the page topic unambiguous.
findings.fix: Demote all but the main headline to <h2>.

findings.title: Search snippet barely matches the query
findings.evidence: Snippet shown for “stripe pricing”: “Pay monthly. Annual subscription. Paid monthly. Based on a volume tier that works for your business. Starting at $620.00. per month, 1-year…” — little term overlap with the query, so engines may be improvising this page's description.
findings.fix: Rewrite the meta description to answer the query directly; search engines often adopt a well-written description verbatim.

findings.title: A browsing AI understands the page
findings.evidence: Agent's one-line read: “This is Stripe's official pricing page detailing fee structures and costs for their payment processing and financial services products.”. Key facts it extracted: Standard payments pricing is 2.9% + 30¢ per successful domestic card transactio…; Stripe supports 195+ countries, 135+ currencies, and 100+ payment methods with …; Product categories include Global Payments (Payments, Link, Checkout, Terminal,…
findings.fix: Keep the opening screen this clear; make sure the key facts stay in static text.

findings.title: Ranks #1 for “stripe pricing”
findings.evidence: Strong: position 1 for the target query. Protect it.
findings.fix: Keep this page fresh (update stats/dates) and watch the competitors listed in the report.

key_facts: Standard payments pricing is 2.9% + 30¢ per successful domestic card transaction, with additional fees for international cards (+1.5%), currency conversion (+1%), and manually entered cards (+0.5%)
Stripe supports 195+ countries, 135+ currencies, and 100+ payment methods with a 99.999% historical uptime claim and a Forrester-verified 326% return on investment

Product categories include Global Payments (Payments, Link, Checkout, Terminal, etc.), Money Management (Connect, Treasury, Issuing), Revenue and Finance Automation (Billing, Tax, Invoicing, Sigma), and More (Radar, Identity, Atlas, Climate, Workflows)
